_meta.method: EMMA scrape (browser-fingerprint session + Disclaimer.aspx CUSIP-license postback) -> Official Statement PDF cover maturity-schedule, plaintext CUSIPs read directly (EMMA scale JSON returns only the encrypted Cusip9Enc token).
_meta.scraper_bugfix: emma_scraper._partial_pdf_links regex was hardcoded to '/P'-prefixed OS filenames; fixed to accept any 1-2 letter prefix (ER/EP/ES/SS...), which unblocked the non-P issues (Clovis, San Jose, Fontana TABs).
_meta.representative_definition: Per user decision (2026-05-30): each issuer has many series; 'cusip' is the REPRESENTATIVE = longest-dated live maturity (usually the final term bond) of the chosen representative series. NOT the whole obligor. Full per-maturity ladders live in the OS PDFs cached under data/_emma_cache and /tmp/emma_os.
_meta.confidence: HIGH for the representative CUSIP + base (read from the OS cover table). par/final_maturity/n_maturities are from EMMA scale JSON (verified). Early rungs of refunding series may already be matured (we are in 2026).
